steps.title: Get Accepted by a Turkish University
steps.notes: You must first be accepted into a program at a university in Turkey. This is the foundational step for your student visa application.
docs: Letter of Acceptance from a Turkish University

steps.title: Apply for Your Turkish Student Visa
steps.notes: Once you have your acceptance letter, the agent will fill out the student visa application form at the nearest Turkish Consulate or Embassy in your home country on your behalf. You will need to provide the required documents.
docs: Original Passport (valid for at least 6 months beyond your intended stay)
Letter of Acceptance from a Turkish University
Proof of financial means (e.g., bank statements, scholarship letters) to cover your expenses in Turkey
Travel health insurance valid for your stay
Proof of accommodation (e.g., dormitory letter, rental agreement)

steps.title: Travel to Turkey and Apply for a Residence Permit
steps.notes: After arriving in Turkey with your student visa, you must apply for a Student Residence Permit (─░kamet ─░zni) with the Directorate General of Migration Management within one month of your arrival. This is crucial for your legal stay in Turkey.
docs: Student Certificate (to be obtained from your university in Turkey)

steps.title: University Enrollment
steps.notes: Complete your final registration and enrollment at your university after settling in. This usually involves presenting original documents and paying tuition fees.
